## What it is

Partie ouest de l'ancien `boitier_int`. Bac DC, chanfrein sud-ouest ouvert, face est à x = 50, nord à y = 95 (haut machine). Deux puits d'aimant Ø8×3 (bas SW et NW contre le mur de la marche). Deux logements Wago : NW (221-423, surélevé de 2mm) et angle de la marche (221-423 + 221-422, contre le mur ouest). Six heat inserts M2.5 : deux dans le coin NE (module CAN, fusionnés aux faces externes), quatre pour le second module (rectangulaire, coin SE). Face est : ouverture dimmer (nord, y = 77–93,4, dès z = 18,6) et fente SSR (sud, y = 66–74, dès z = 7), calées sur AC ouest depuis y_max.

## Design notes

Printed floor on the bed. Outer 50 × 95 × 25 mm. East face at `aile_x` (50) from the south up to `boitier_int_y` (95). North wall at y = 95 from the marche (x = 12) to x = 50. Marche SW corner zone enlarged 3mm in Y. NW Wago bay raised 2mm on a solid platform; north magnet well pad fused into its sill. SW Wago bay has two surplombs: muret side at z = 14.8mm, west wall side at z = 20.4mm. East wall: dimmer opening and SSR slot from `system.ouvertures_modules` (same Y-from-north and Z as AC west).

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 0.6
```

## Don't

- Do not add 5 mm on X: that was the first-cut error, the module overflows in Y.
- Do not restore `prolongement_nord` or the Y nest: DC runs to y = 95, AC is entirely east of x = 50 (user 2026-09-03).
- Do not cut a notch or interlocking in the east face: square wall, linking later. The dimmer and SSR slots matching AC west are the exception (user 2026-09-03).
- Do not invent Y for those slots: they come from `ouvertures_modules` (distance from y_max), same recipe as AC west (user 2026-09-03).
- Do not chamfer the inner north-east corner (Z edges of the remaining north wall at the east face) (user 2026-09-03).
- Do not restore the seven M2 spacers or the old Wago platform.
- Do not close the low-X half of the 45° chamfer.
- Do not position NW features (Wago bay, north magnet well) relative to x=0: the west face in the NW zone is at x=marche_x (12), not x=0. The seuil at x=0 caused an OCCT segfault from coplanar faces.
